leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a generic sortBy function that accepts typed arrays and sort keys
Apply type constraints to ensure sort keys exist on array elements
Construct a comparator function that dynamically accesses nested object properties
Configure the function to handle both ascending and descending sort orders
Integrate the typed helper into existing TypeScript code with proper imports
Manipulate array data using the typed sortBy helper with different data structures
Initialize type-safe function parameters with default values for optional arguments
